steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each live campaign's pacing is placed through the day.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Result count zero while spend continues
findings.fix: Pause the campaign and check tracking

findings.title: Spend more than 20 percent off the daily plan
Cost per result more than 30 percent off target

outcome.notChecked: Platform data quality; attribution; creative performance; campaigns with no export.
